_comment: Project-shared MCP server config (Claude Code / Cursor / Continue / etc.).
Picked up automatically by any tool that reads .mcp.json from repo root.
v0.4.40 adds codebase-memory-mcp (DeusData) — a local code-intelligence
MCP server that indexes the repo into a SQLite knowledge graph and exposes
tools for tracing call paths, detecting dead code, and querying architecture.
It runs IN YOUR EDITOR'S MCP CLIENT, not in any Docker container — see
docs/codebase-memory-mcp.md for the install + the rationale for keeping
it out of the production runtime.
If `codebase-memory-mcp` is not on $PATH this config is a no-op (the MCP
client emits a 'tool unavailable' warning and continues). The repo stays
